nodes.title: Place spectrophotometer
nodes.description: Place the spectrophotometer on the workbench.

feedback.retry: Review Place spectrophotometer and try again.

nodes.title: Measure stock dye
nodes.description: Pour 5 mL of stock dye into the graduated cylinder.

feedback.retry: Review Measure stock dye and try again.

nodes.title: Transfer stock dye
nodes.description: Pour the measured dye into the volumetric flask.

feedback.retry: Review Transfer stock dye and try again.

nodes.title: Dilute standard
nodes.description: Pour deionized water into the volumetric flask to the calibration mark.

feedback.retry: Review Dilute standard and try again.

nodes.title: Fill cuvette
nodes.description: Pour the diluted standard into the cuvette.

feedback.retry: Review Fill cuvette and try again.

nodes.title: Record transmittance
nodes.description: Record percent transmittance from the spectrophotometer.

feedback.retry: Review Record transmittance and try again.

nodes.title: Calculate absorbance
nodes.description: Calculate absorbance from the recorded percent transmittance.

feedback.retry: Review Calculate absorbance and try again.
